title: Transport Egress Schema V0
description: The machine block of a TE artifact (Transport Standard V0 §7): the classification of PGC outcomes into protocol-neutral Result Classes, the output contract and the evidence exposure policy. It carries no protocol semantics (TE_RESULT_CLASS_PROTOCOL_INDEPENDENT).

fqdn.description: Authoritative declared identity (namespace::code). Folder location has no authority over identity.

supersedes.description: FQDN of the artifact this one stands in place of. A declared relation between two exact identities, not a resolution rule: references stay exact, and a superseded artifact is unreachable rather than absent.

authority.description: The authority from which this artifact's jurisdiction derives (CA-1, CA-2). Declared, never inferred from namespace, path or kind.

concern.description: The semantic subject this artifact is about (GO-11, ID-12). A concern classification confers no authority and constitutes no boundary.

operation.description: The Operation Identity whose results this contract projects

result_classification.description: Each PGC outcome and the Result Class it is classified as (standard §7)

default_result_class.description: The Result Class of an outcome the classification does not name

from.description: Where the value is read: the result surface or the admitted input. A `$name` segment is replaced by the input field of that name.

output_contract.description: The result payload exposed, field by field; raw passthrough is forbidden (TE_PROJECTION_NORMALIZED)

evidence_policy.description: Which evidence references leave the boundary
